Chapter 645 - 645 Modifications; Thanks!

Chapter 645 - 645 Modifications; Thanks!

645 Modifications; Thanks!

After Chen Ming pressed the last note, the audience applauded.

Some people echoed with praise.

“Well played!”

“It sounded good!”

“That was great!”

However, almost everyone’s attention was focused on Lin Fan.

Everyone had heard Lin Fan’s piano performance earlier and was looking forward to his next performance.

Finally, Lin Fan placed his hands on the piano keys.

Instantly…

Cheerful, high-spirited, and intense music surged out like waves.

Almost everyone was moving their bodies to the rhythm of the music.

This was an instinctive reaction!

Soul resonance!

As the piano music continued, a young man and a young woman seemed to appear in everyone’s field of vision.

They ran against the wind, went into the sea to catch fish, and finally, flew into the sky…

They sweated freely and without restraint.

This was youth!

Passion, high spirits, freedom!

Everyone’s faces were filled with yearning.

Finally, the music stopped.

Everyone could not help but clap. It was a thunderous applause.

This was a recognition of the performance, and at the same time, it was a reminiscence of their youth!

This included Dai Weiya, Xia Xue, and even Chen Ming.

However, Chen Ming quickly reacted.

He suppressed the shock in his heart and rolled his eyes. “Lin Fan, when you play the piano, you have to pay more attention to your foundation.

“Youth was composed by our school’s Professor Chen Zuzhi. Professor Chen Zuzhi even won first prize for an international piano competition because of it.

“The rhythm of the whole song is fast, light, and perfect. Your second and third notes have two differences. Although the overall flow was considered smooth… If Professor Chen Zuzhi heard you playing like this, he’d probably be angry.”

Chen Ming was like an elder, commenting on Lin Fan’s piano performance.

Most people thought that Lin Fan played very well.

However, after hearing Chen Ming’s words, they could not help but hesitate and agree.

At this moment, hurried footsteps suddenly sounded from outside.

Then, a middle-aged man wearing black-rimmed glasses and a white shirt walked in quickly.

“Who?” he asked excitedly. “Who was the one who played Youth?”

When everyone heard this, they could not help but look toward the door.

Soon, someone exclaimed, “Professor Chen Zuzhi?!”

This person was the creator of Youth, Chen Zuzhi!

“Hello, Professor Chen!”

However, Chen Zuzhi did not seem to hear everyone’s greetings. He spoke again, “Who was the one who played Youth just now?”

Instantly, everyone’s gaze landed on Lin Fan.

“Can I trouble you to play it again?” Chen Zuzhi asked excitedly.

Lin Fan nodded. “Sure.”

It was equally cheerful.

It was equally high-spirited.

It was equally intense.

It was also like the waves of the sea, surging continuously.

In this song, Chen Zuzhi saw his own pursuit of knowledge, fighting spirit, and youth!

The song ended.

Chen Zuzhi clapped hard and shouted, “Good! That was great! This is the true Youth! Thank you for perfecting the flaws that have always existed.”

Silence!

The entire scene was silent!

Who was Chen Zuzhi? He was a music professor at Jiangbei University!

He had even won the first prize in an international piano competition!

What did they hear?

Chen Zuzhi was actually thanking Lin Fan for helping to perfect Youth! He did something that even Chen Zuzhi could not do!

Immediately after, everyone recalled what Chen Ming had said.

‘Your second and third notes have two differences. Although the overall flow was considered smooth… If Professor Chen Zuzhi heard you playing like this, he’d probably be angry.’

Therefore, everyone could not help but look at Chen Ming.

Chen Ming seemed to have sensed the strange gazes from everyone, and his entire face suddenly turned red.

It was too much of a slap in the face.

He did not expect Professor Chen to suddenly appear here and even give Lin Fan such a high evaluation.

Chen Zuzhi ignored everyone and asked, “My name is Chen Zuzhi. May I know your name?”

“I’m Lin Fan,” Lin Fan said.

“May I ask how you discovered the problem with Youth and made adjustments, Mr. Lin?”

“Musical intuition,” Lin Fan said.

“I see.” Chen Zuzhi nodded.

Musical intuition was a very mysterious and real thing.

To put it simply, it was talent!

Then, Chen Zuzhi seemed to have thought of something and said, “Mr. Lin, have you heard of my To the Future?”

Lin Fan shook his head. “Never heard of it.”

Although Youth had won the first prize at an international piano competition, the popularity of To the Future was not lower than it. It might even be higher.

Lin Fan directly said that he had never heard of To the Future. From a certain perspective, it was extremely impolite.

However, Chen Zuzhi was not angry.

“Then I’ll play it for you on the spot. What do you think?”

Lin Fan looked at the people around him and said, “If they agree, then of course. After all, this is a banquet for the student council.”

Just as Chen Zuzhi was about to ask again, President Zuo of the student union, who was far away, quickly said, “This banquet needs music. Since Professor Chen is willing to play, it’s a great chance for us to enjoy it. We can’t wait. How could we disagree?”

“Then I’ll borrow the place to play a tune.” Chen Zuzhi smiled.

As he spoke, he looked at Chen Ming, who was sitting in front of another piano.

Chen Ming was stunned for a moment before he said, “Professor Chen, if you don’t mind, you can use this piano here.”

“Then I won’t stand on ceremony,” said Chen Zuzhi.

After saying that, he strode forward.

It had to be said that Chen Zuzhi was indeed a piano master who had obtained many awards.

Whether it was the movements or the rhythm of the music, everything was great.

Everyone listened attentively.

This was Chen Zuzhi!

Under normal circumstances, everyone would only have the chance to listen from afar during a concert.

How could they listen at such a close distance like now?

The music finally stopped.

Chen Zuzhi raised his head slowly and looked at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan said, “You want to ask about the fourth part and the fifth part, right?”

Chen Zuzhi’s eyes lit up as he said excitedly, “Yes! Mr. Lin, do you have any thoughts on changing these parts?”
